nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Overnight Hydrating Mask with 10.5% Squalane

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe the balm as too heavy and greasy, sitting on the surface and causing overnight transfer to the pillow, with one saying she is oily and 'don't like thick cream' so it isn't for her.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including those in cold or dry climates, report the mask relieves flaking and tightness and is described as a must-have, though some still find it too rich to sleep on.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the texture feels immediately greasy and stains pillowcases, with one calling it too thick even though it moisturizes well.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer sensitive to Aquaphor around the eyes avoided it as a night cream but liked it as a cleansing balm, while others report burning, itching, and a rash after use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s–60s) report it calms and softens skin, helps barrier issues and tightness, and is considered worth the price for decades-long use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using retinol/tretinol alongside this mask report improved texture and reduced flaking overnight; one long-term mature user credits it with repairing her skin barrier.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report strong overnight hydration and softness, especially in winter or dry climates; a minority still woke up with dry patches or flakiness despite using it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer describes calming effects and reduced tightness, but this concern is rarely addressed directly across reviews.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user credits the product with 'saving her barrier' repeatedly; another with an eczema-prone barrier found it too irritating due to fragrance/odor rather than texture.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone skin are split: several report it does not clog pores and prevents breakouts, while others describe bad breakouts, cystic irritation, and a rash within days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Some acne-prone reviewers highlight it as their 'go to' without new blemishes, while at least one reports it broke her out badly with burning and itching.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily or combination consistently report a greasy after-feel and pillow transfer, with several finding it unusable in that skin state.

aspects.libelle: Waxy or hard to scoop from jar
Works well as a cleansing balm

extraits.texte: Decided to give this mask a try after seeing it on Tik Tok. I was super excited because my skin has been extremely dry and flaky. Anyway… I ordered and it came in the mail, off the bat it felt great on my skin but then out of nowhere my skin started burning and itching like crazy. I had to wash it off immediately, next morning I woke up with a really bad rash on my face that lasted days.

Now that winter is TRULY here, I've been on the hunt for a decent sleeping mask to hydrate and get my skin back to normal. I can't use anything too rich in the daytime as that means foundation will end up oxidizing as my skin can get quite oily. And with this I unfortunately just can't get past the consistency - it's very thick, almost like petroleum jelly and just sits on the surface of my skin. I'm used to sleeping on my side but once this is on I just dare not as it will end up all over my pillowcase. Have also tried using a really tiny amount but awoke to dry patches/flakiness which means it wasn't enough, yet any more is too much. Can't seem to find a middle ground with this one! Ingredients-wise there isn't a great deal in here, it's basic and simple stuff - good for those who have skin sensitivities and have to avoid many ingredients but not for those who are looking for a state of the art formulation, which this sure isn't! Definitely more suited to drier or very dehydrated skin types. extraits.titre: Not the best not the worst
extraits.texte: I have acne prone combo skin type. I have seen and heard a lot of bad and good things about this mask and decided to try it. I have never done another overnight mask before. It felt immediately greasy once i put it on. I sleep on my side and move a lot in my sleep so i didnt know what to expect but my satin pillowcase is stained with this product. And i feel like i have bacon grease on my face when wake up. But it does do a very good job of moisturizing. And my skin after does feel really nice but the level of grease that i felt was not enough for me to ever buy this again.

I have super breakout prone skin that gets incredibly dry on planes and in the winter. This is a must have for me. I use it a few times a week when my skin is dry and the normal daily moisturizer isnt enough. I see a lot of complaints about the texture/greasiness, so just want to share my own directions that work well for me. 1) get a nickel/quarter sized amount on my finger, 2) rub it with my other fingers for a few second to warm it up and get it softer, 3) dab onto my face and rub in gently focusing on especially dry spots, 4) keep massaging it in for about a minute until it feels mostly absorbed, 5) wait 30 minutes to put my face directly on my pillow. I have never had issues with it staining my pillows, though it did feel more "heavy" than I was used to the first few times I used it.

I am someone that has very dry & acne prone. I had SO much trouble finding something hydrating that also did not clog my pores. Once I started using this product about 2 years ago I simply could not turn back. I definitely use this product not really as the way its intended though. I apply this in the morning and let it soak into my skin all day and I also wear it over night. I personally love the consistency and it keeps my skin looking hydrated all day & when I wake up. I use the paired with the Kiehls moisturizer…. chefs kiss.

extraits.titre: One of my favorite Kiehl's products
extraits.texte: Im in my 60's. I have used this for decades ( since they first came out with this) This product has saved my barrier many times! Its calming, hydrating and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. I use it about twice a week ( can be used more often) for me that's enough for it to make my skin feel less tight. Well worth the money.

LOVE the Ultra Facial cream. However, during the cold, dry winter months it was not enough for my aging dry skin which is prone to eczema. Thought the Ultra Facial Overnight Hydrating Mask with Squalene would do the trick. It was extremely moisturizing, but I absolutely could not tolerate the odor of the cream. Returned, and will use the regular version and add an odorless squalene oil.
